stories.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
stories.body: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

stories.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
stories.body: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

stories.title: Journalists denied White House access after Trump banned some media outlets
stories.body: CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters' White House press badges were confiscated, the outlets reported.

stories.title: Converse pulls 'deeply upsetting' advert after backlash
stories.body: Social media users say an image from the brand's Instagram account resembled a KKK hood and hanging.

stories.title: Trump says US will form 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence tsar
stories.body: The president said his administration "will not in any way hinder or stifle the growth" amid amid warnings about the emergent technology.

stories.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
stories.body: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.

stories.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
stories.body: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

stories.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
stories.body: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

stories.title: Shark attack prompts rare kill order in Western Australia as victim named
stories.body: Greg O'Neill "loved the ocean", his family say, as police boats and helicopters patrol Perth's beaches in search of his body and the shark that attacked him.

stories.title: Millions without power as Cuba hit by latest major blackout
stories.body: Widespread power outages have become increasingly common due to fuel shortages made worse by a US blockade.

stories.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
stories.body: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

stories.title: Kerry Kennedy: 'It would be a tragedy' if Kennedy Center is demolished
stories.body: The BBC’s Caitríona Perry spoke to the late president's niece, as protesters gathered at the venue to condemn demolition threats.

stories.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
stories.body: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.

stories.title: Ryanair boss Michael O'Leary apologises over 'high-fare rapists' remarks
stories.body: O'Leary described his choice of language as "careless" and said "it won't happen again".

stories.title: A four-minute warning isn't enough: Russia's new relentless missile tactics exhaust Kyiv residents
stories.body: Increasingly frequent and ferocious attacks on the Ukrainian capital have left many on edge.

stories.title: I found love at an Irish matchmaking festival - and I want others to do the same
stories.body: Mary Timby flew to Ireland on a whim last year and met her boyfriend at a matchmaking festival.

stories.title: Tata Sons: India's corporate crown braces for upheaval amid boardroom revolt
stories.body: The Tata boardroom battle has intensified over a re-appointment of its chairman and a diktat to go public.

stories.title: Why US plan to sell F-35 warplanes to Saudi Arabia is controversial
stories.body: Saudi Arabia has lobbied the US for years to buy F35s, the world's most advanced fighter jet.

stories.title: Canadians dream of Europe as Carney floats longshot plan for living and working in EU
stories.body: Torontonians are excited by the possibility of moving to the EU, even if it is unlikely anytime soon.

stories.title: This Olympic river has 500 crocodiles in it - but that's not the main concern
stories.body: Queensland's Fitzroy River has been selected for the 2032 Games, despite concerns over the course - and its inhabitants.

However, contested signals and emerging vulnerabilities, particularly in technology and governance, highlight the need for careful navigation of risks. **Watch for developments in three key areas:** (1) the operationalization of the U.S. AI Force and its impact on global tech competition; (2) international responses to the Greenland deal and Russia sanctions, particularly from adversaries; and (3) societal reactions to governance practices, including media access restrictions and public safety measures.
